description: This is a SwiftUI source file defining the OnboardingWizardView for an iOS app. It manages the onboarding flow, including QR code scanning, manual setup, connection status, and authentication for connecting to an OpenClaw gateway.

classes.name: OnboardingStep
classes.description: Enumeration representing the steps in the onboarding process, with utility properties for navigation and display.

classes.name: OnboardingWizardView
classes.description: Main SwiftUI view managing the onboarding process, including QR scanning, manual setup, connection status, and authentication.

methods.name: handleScannedLink
methods.description: Processes a scanned QR code link, extracts connection parameters, updates state, and initiates connection.

methods.name: openQRScannerFromOnboarding
methods.description: Prepares the app to open the QR scanner for onboarding gateway connection.

methods.name: resumeAfterPairingApproval
methods.description: Retries the last connection attempt after user approval, handling reconnection logic.

methods.name: attemptAutomaticPairingResumeIfNeeded
methods.description: Automatically attempts to resume pairing if conditions are met and enough time has passed.

methods.name: detectQRCode
methods.description: Detects and extracts QR code message string from image data.

methods.name: advanceFromIntro
methods.description: Moves onboarding flow from intro step to the welcome step.

methods.name: navigateBack
methods.description: Navigates to the previous onboarding step.

methods.name: connectManual
methods.description: Initiates manual connection to a gateway using user-provided host and port.

methods.name: retryLastAttempt
methods.description: Retries the last gateway connection, optionally silently.

methods.name: saveGatewayCredentials
methods.description: Stores gateway token and password persistently.

methods.name: saveGatewayBootstrapToken
methods.description: Stores bootstrap token for a gateway.

methods.name: connectDiscoveredGateway
methods.description: Connects to a discovered gateway asynchronously.

methods.name: selectMode
methods.description: Selects a connection mode and applies default settings.

methods.name: applyModeDefaults
methods.description: Applies default host, port, and TLS settings based on selected connection mode.

methods.name: gatewayHasResolvableHost
methods.description: Checks if a discovered gateway has a resolvable LAN or DNS host.
